# `files_put_object`

Upload an inline file (≤4 MB) and get back a CloudFront-signed download link; requires msg/files:write. Supports DryRun.

## Input schema

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "Body": {
      "description": "UTF-8 text, or base64 when ContentEncoding is base64; at most 4 MB decoded",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ContentDisposition": {
      "description": "attachment (default) or inline",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ContentEncoding": {
      "description": "base64 or identity (default identity)",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ContentType": {
      "description": "MIME type; text/html and executables are refused",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "DateLessThan": {
      "description": "Absolute RFC 3339 link expiry",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "DryRun": {
      "description": "Validate and run guardrails, return the would-be call without uploading",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "ExpiresIn": {
      "description": "ISO-8601 duration for the link, e.g. P3D; exactly one of ExpiresIn/DateLessThan",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "FileName": {
      "description": "Name the download should carry, e.g. report.pdf",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Key": {
      "description": "Optional object name; the server always prefixes shared/\u003cuuid\u003e/ and defaults to FileName",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "Metadata": {
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Extra object metadata",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "FileName",
    "ContentType",
    "Body"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```
